whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Family Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant is located in Buddha Colony, Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for online menu browsing and table reservations.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme digital food menu, table reservation inquiry, aur direct WhatsApp order button integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/family

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Family Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Family Restaurant) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar Buddha Colony location ke hisaab se WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a digital menu showcase and direct WhatsApp booking. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
